# mimecast_whoami (Data Source)

Read typed identity and account-code metadata for the current OAuth client.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "mimecast_whoami" "current" {}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Read-Only

- `account_code_cg` (String, Sensitive) Cloud Gateway target account code.
- `account_code_ci` (String, Sensitive) Cloud Integrated target account code.
- `account_code_lead` (String, Sensitive) Lead target account code.
- `account_code_x1` (String, Sensitive) X1 target account code.
- `home_account_code_cg` (String, Sensitive) Cloud Gateway home account code.
- `home_account_code_ci` (String, Sensitive) Cloud Integrated home account code.
- `home_account_code_lead` (String, Sensitive) Lead home account code.
- `home_account_code_x1` (String, Sensitive) X1 home account code.
- `id` (String) Stable identity data source ID.
- `type` (String) Mimecast account type.
- `version` (String) Response contract version.
